name: Gumloop
long_description:
Gumloop is the multiplayer AI agent builder. Let anyone at your company build agents with any AI model and any integration, while IT controls access and spend.

Agents reflect on their own runs and improve over time, drawing on one shared company brain: your internal knowledge, the skills your team runs on, and live context from every tool you use.

Disclaimer: Gumloop is not a visual workflow builder. It is an agent builder.
one_liner: The multiplayer AI agent builder. Let anyone build, IT controls access

launches.body:
**📝TL;DR:**

* 🛠️ Use a **drag-and-drop workflow builder** to automate complex workflows with AI
* **🔗 Integrations** with GitHub, GMail, Outlook, Twitter, etc.
* Try [AgentHub](https://agenthub.dev/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) **for free** using [45+ ready-to-run automations](https://www.agenthub.dev/templates?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) or build your own automations for Software Development, Sales/CRM, Media/News, HR & Hiring, Administration, Financial Analysis, and more

Hey everyone! We’re Max and Rahul from AgentHub. After experiencing the shortcomings of autonomous AI agents, we’ve been on a mission to make AI powered automations cost-effective, reliable and intuitive for anyone to build.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75408&key=user_uploads/1018752/14e5b30d-5e4b-42df-9482-1c37ab1cbd36)

### **What We've Built 🏗️**

AgentHub is a platform that lets builders drag, drop, and connect **modular components** onto a canvas to **automate manual and repetitive employee workflows** end-to-end.

The platform gives builders the tools and infra to operate at 10x the speed of writing, testing, and productionizing code.

#### **Drag & Drop**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75408&key=user_uploads/1018752/4fe66eea-10a0-4914-8c77-eb7cace1dc16)

#### **Link**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75408&key=user_uploads/1018752/3b714c52-cfdc-4fe7-897e-15577ab39c2b)

#### **Run**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75408&key=user_uploads/1018752/7cc0b737-faea-49bf-880f-3307601396f1)

Try out some of our prebuilt automations for inspiration:

* [GitHub PR Description Inserter:](https://www.agenthub.dev/templates/software_development/github_pr_description_inserter?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) Reads all the changes in your pull-request and adds a point form description in seconds.
* [Multi-Article Summarizer:](https://www.agenthub.dev/templates/media_news/multi_article_summarizer?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) Summarize any number of articles (or websites) for news or lead aggregation.
* [Hiring Candidate Ranking System:](https://www.agenthub.dev/templates/education/automated_grading_system?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) Ranks candidate resumes based on custom criteria and various factors like qualifications, skills, etc.
* [Daily Stock Report Generation:](https://www.agenthub.dev/templates/financial_analysis/daily_stock_report_generation?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc) Generate a 1-page PDF report on the recent trends of specified stock tickers

### **Why We Built It**

Most companies have **extremely manual tasks** that employees do **hundreds or thousands of times per month**. These tasks were hard to automate with traditional automation tools because they required some degree of **human reasoning**.

LLMs exposed reasoning via an API, so AgentHub was created as an **AI-first platform** that doesn't aim to simply streamline an employee's workflow, but can **completely replace it end-to-end**.

The flexibility of our automation builder allows for extremely complex workflows to be automated. **If Zapier were a calculator, we would be WolframAlpha.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=75408&key=user_uploads/1522221/c00a27cc-ea22-4412-9dea-4691f906d330)

### **How We Started 🌱**

AgentHub started as a UI wrapper for **Auto-GPT**. We quickly realized that people were using the platform to try and automate incredibly niche/complex tasks but **autonomous agents were simply too unreliable and expensive**. Our key insight was that when automating these types of workflows, you really want to **minimize the use of AI**, and keep it to just the core reasoning component of the workflow.

**AgentHub automations are generally 90% infrastructure and 10% AI** resulting in increased consistency and reliability, while being economically efficient at scale.

We are constantly working to add more integrations and operations to the platform. [Request a custom integration here!](https://www.agenthub.dev/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc#request-automation)
